title: China Advises Citizens to Leave Eswatini, Taiwan's Diplomatic Ally
detail: China issued a travel advisory urging its citizens to leave Eswatini, one of Taiwan's remaining formal diplomatic allies, citing vague 'security risks.' The move is widely interpreted as diplomatic pressure on Eswatini to switch recognition from Taipei to Beijing, consistent with China's long-running campaign to isolate Taiwan internationally by eliminating its remaining state partners.

media.caption: China advises citizens to leave Eswatini, a Taiwan diplomatic ally
